COMMANDS:
    license            Manages license keys and switch between Metalama editions
    config             Manages Metalama configuration settings                  
    cleanup            Removes temporary files and cache generated by Metalama  
    shutdown           Stops the processes that keep Metalama files locked after
                       a build: asks them to exit, waits for them, and reports  
                       the ones that remain. Also available as 'kill'           
    telemetry          Manages telemetry settings and upload queued data        
    docs               Opens the Metalama documentation in your browser         
    ui                 Opens the browser-based configuration interface          
    news               Manages toast notifications for new Metalama updates     
    version            Prints version information                               
    divorce            Copies code generated by Metalama back into your source  
                       code, in case you wanted to stop using Metalama          
    preview <files>    Shows the code that Metalama generates for some files of 
                       a project, formatted, without building the project       
    introspect         Queries how Metalama applied aspects to a project, from  
                       the files of its last build. Never builds

DESCRIPTION:
Manages license keys and switch between Metalama editions

USAGE:
    metalama.dll license [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help    Prints help information

COMMANDS:
    list                  Lists all registered licenses                         
    register <license>    Registers a new license key or license server URL. To 
                          register an edition that requires no license key, use 
                          'license community' or 'license free' or 'license try'
    unregister            Unregisters all license keys and license servers      
    acquire-lease         Acquires a lease from the registered license server   
                          and prints the license it leases                      
    community             Switches to the Metalama Community edition, which is  
                          free and must be renewed every year                   
    free                  Registers the Metalama Free license (for Metalama     
                          2025.0 and earlier)                                   
    try                   Activates the Metalama Professional trial period

DESCRIPTION:
Stops the processes that keep Metalama files locked after a build: asks them to 
exit, waits for them, and reports the ones that remain. Also available as 'kill'

USAGE:
    metalama.dll shutdown [OPTIONS]

OPTIONS:
                               DEFAULT                                          
    -h, --help                            Prints help information               
        --verbose                         Prints trace messages                 
        --no-warn                         Does not report any warnings          
        --force                           Cancels the work of the processes, and
                                          ends the ones that have not exited    
                                          when the timeout has elapsed          
        --all                             Also ends the processes that are left 
                                          running by default, such as those of  
                                          integrated development environments   
        --timeout <SECONDS>    60         How long to wait for the processes to 
                                          exit, in seconds

DESCRIPTION:
Manages telemetry settings and upload queued data

USAGE:
    metalama.dll telemetry [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help    Prints help information

COMMANDS:
    enable             Enables telemetry for a scenario (usage, exception,      
                       performance or all)                                      
    disable            Disables telemetry for a scenario (usage, exception,     
                       performance or all)                                      
    reset              Resets telemetry for a scenario (usage, exception,       
                       performance or all) to its default state (review-first   
                       for exceptions and performance problems)                 
    reset-device-id    Generates a new anonymous device identifier for telemetry
    reset-dedup        Clears the record of already-reported issues so they are 
                       captured again (testing aid)                             
    upload             Uploads all queued telemetry data immediately            
    status             Displays current telemetry configuration and status

                           compiler command line

result.stdout:
DESCRIPTION:
Queries how Metalama applied aspects to a project, from the files of its last 
build. Never builds

USAGE:
    metalama.dll introspect [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

EXAMPLES:
    metalama.dll introspect list aspect-instances --where aspectClass/shortName 
eq 'Log'
    metalama.dll introspect show declaration src/Customer.cs:18
    metalama.dll introspect batch --file queries.txt

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help    Prints help information

COMMANDS:
    list <COLLECTION>               Lists the objects of a collection that      
                                    satisfy conditions                          
    show <COLLECTION> <SELECTOR>    Shows one object with what relates to it,   
                                    such as a declaration with its aspects and  
                                    their transformations in order              
    schema                          Describes the collections and their fields, 
                                    which --where, --select and --order-by use  
    batch                           Runs several queries, one per line of the   
                                    standard input or of --file, over one load  
                                    of the files. Each line is a command without
                                    'introspect', such as 'show declaration     
                                    src/Customer.cs:18'

Disables telemetry for a scenario (usage, exception, performance or all)

USAGE:
    metalama.dll telemetry disable [scenario] [OPTIONS]

ARGUMENTS:
    [scenario]    The kind of telemetry to configure: 'usage', 'exception',     
                  'performance' or 'all'. Defaults to 'all'                     

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help       Prints help information     
        --verbose    Prints trace messages       
        --no-warn    Does not report any warnings

DESCRIPTION:
Uploads all queued telemetry data immediately

USAGE:
    metalama.dll telemetry upload [OPTIONS]

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help       Prints help information                                    
        --verbose    Prints trace messages                                      
        --no-warn    Does not report any warnings                               
    -a, --async      Run the upload asynchronously in a background process      
    -f, --force      Force the upload even if another upload has been performed 
                     recently

EXAMPLES:
    metalama.dll introspect list aspect-instances --where aspectClass/shortName 
eq 'Log'

ARGUMENTS:
    <COLLECTION>    The collection: aspect-classes, aspect-instances,           
                    predecessors, transformations, annotations,                 
                    declaration-mappings, declarations or diagnostics           

OPTIONS:
                                           DEFAULT                              
    -h, --help                                        Prints help information   
        --project <PATH>                              The project: a project    
                                                      file, or a directory that 
                                                      holds one. By default, the
                                                      only project or solution  
                                                      of the current directory  
        --solution <PATH>                             The solution: a .sln or   
                                                      .slnx file, or a directory
                                                      that holds one            
    -f, --framework <TFM>                             Restricts the query to one
                                                      target framework, such as

    -c, --configuration <CONFIGURATION>               The configuration of the  
                                                      build output. By default, 
                                                      the default configuration

                                                      Debug

EXAMPLES:
    metalama.dll introspect show declaration src/Customer.cs:18

ARGUMENTS:
    <COLLECTION>    The kind of object: declaration, aspect-instance,           
                    predecessor or aspect-class                                 
    <SELECTOR>      The object: a source position (src/Customer.cs:42), a C#    
                    name without parameters, possibly partial                   
                    (Customer.FullName), a short aspect class name (Log), an    
                    identifier or a unique prefix of it, or an exact
